blockers.finding: The disjointness expression compares `fit_groups.train` IDs against `fit_groups.valid` and `evaluation_valid_groups` as bare integers. Train and valid parquet row-group numbers are separate source namespaces and can legitimately overlap numerically, so this rejects valid accepted cache metadata.
blockers.required_correction: Validate train membership within the train namespace; validate fit-valid against evaluation-valid only within the shared valid namespace; bind source-qualified memberships/order to the accepted producer provenance. Re-pin all affected packet bytes before admission.

blockers.finding: The post-submit `systemctl show` subprocess has a timeout but no `TimeoutExpired` handler. If that read times out after a successful or unknown submission, the function can exit before durably writing `LAUNCH.json`.
blockers.required_correction: Record the timeout as an unknown observation and always persist the launch record; never retry the submission. Re-pin the corrected template and preparation packet.

compatibility_note: The pinned source requires Python >=3.11, so datetime.UTC is available under that floor. Using datetime.timezone.utc remains the requested portability cleanup; it is not treated as a separate runtime blocker.
